archetypes.name: launcher-parity
archetypes.rationale: Three CI launchers (cursor/codex/claude) receive symmetric prompt-fragment injections; verify the plan fully and identically specifies the change across all three launchers and their tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the plan's instructions for modifying launch-cursor-ci.sh, launch-codex-ci.sh, and launch-claude-ci.sh and verify that the fragment-injection logic, PROMPT insertion point, guard condition, and sibling .md update are specified identically for all three. Check whether the plan's sentinel-substring test assertions are described symmetrically across all three test scripts (test-launch-cursor-ci.sh, test-launch-codex-ci.sh, test-launch-claude-ci.sh). Identify any launcher where the plan is vague, asymmetric, or omits a step that is explicitly described for another launcher. Confirm the fragment load path ($SCRIPT_DIR/../skills/shared/ci-fix-failure-patterns.md vs $PLUGIN_ROOT variant) is consistently resolved across all three launchers' planned changes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: exit-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan wires ci-decide.sh to emit BAIL_REASON=fix-attempts-exhausted making exit-3 reachable for the first time; verify all callers and consumers of ship-pr.sh exit codes are fully accounted for.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every caller and consumer of ship-pr.sh's exit codes referenced in the plan and in the existing codebase — skills/implement/SKILL.md Step 16 (line 1595), scripts/ship-pr.md, and any orchestrator scripts that branch on ship-pr.sh exit values. Verify the plan explicitly addresses each consumer's behavioral change when exit-3 now fires at the FIX_ATTEMPTS>=10 cap, which was previously unreachable dead code. Check whether the plan's new regression test for the exit-4 vendor-loop-exhaustion path is correctly isolated from the new exit-3 path so both code paths can be independently exercised in the test harness. Confirm the plan does not leave any consumer implicitly relying on exit-3 being dead code, particularly any error-handling prose in SKILL.md or ship-pr.md that describes exit-3 as a non-firing path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: batch-registration
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds a new larch-log batch slug across three coordinated files; verify the registration is complete, correctly column-formatted, properly guarded, and failure-tolerant.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the plan's larch-log batch registration steps for completeness: the new final-bail-reason row in larch-log-batches.sh must use the correct three-column format (.txt, replace, none) matching the existing table schema in that file. Verify the refresh-run-logs.sh write call is guarded with [ -f ] and failure-tolerant (|| true pattern), consistent with how token-report and timing-report writes are handled in that script. Check whether the plan's write call in refresh-run-logs.sh uses the correct environment variable name ($IMPL_TMPDIR vs $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR) matching what that script actually sets. Confirm the plan places the new batch write step after the existing post-merge short-circuit guard (lines ~30-35) so no spurious post-merge log commit occurs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
